comment.text: A title for a step in the Rooms onboarding tour, appearing when guiding users to create their first room.

usage.context:
// 7. Closing action: the empty screen's options, or the "New" button.
 isDemo && demoHooks

 EMPTY_SCREEN_CREATE_SELECTOR,
 t("RoomsTour:RoomsCreateFirstTitle"),
 t("FilesTour:TourCreateFirstEmpty"),
 callbacks,
 FILES_TOUR_LABEL,
 demoHooks,
 )

// 7. Closing action: the empty screen's options, or the "New" button.

 EMPTY_SCREEN_CREATE_SELECTOR,

 )
